records.title: Quantum Key Distribution Protocol and Photonic Transmitter for Satellite-to-Ground Free-Space Optical Cryptographic Channels
records.description: Entanglement-based quantum key generation system incorporating adaptive beam steering and atmospheric turbulence compensation for secure satellite communications.

records.title: Anion Exchange Membrane Water Electrolyzer with Non-Precious Transition Metal Catalyst for Cost-Effective Green Hydrogen Generation
records.description: Electrocatalytic water splitting stack utilizing nickel-iron phosphide catalysts on nickel foam substrates for scalable industrial green hydrogen production.

records.title: Engineered Microbial Host and Metabolic Pathway for High-Yield Biosynthesis of 2,3-Butanediol from Lignocellulosic Hydrolysate
records.description: Synthetic biology and metabolic engineering of bacterial strains incorporating CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing for programmable bio-manufacturing of industrial chemicals.
records.organization: International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB) New Delhi
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. Syed Shams Yazdani, Naseem Mansoori

records.title: Synthetic Genetic Circuits for Programmable Biosensing of Heavy Metals and Pathogen Toxins in Aqueous Media
records.description: Cell-free synthetic biology expression cassette comprising modular transcriptional repressor gates for ultra-sensitive environmental contaminant diagnostics.

records.title: Additively Manufactured Semi-Cryogenic Rocket Engine Injector Head and Regenerative Cooling Jacket for Reusable Launch Vehicles
records.description: Monolithic nickel-superalloy coaxial swirl injector matrix fabricated using selective laser melting for throttling reusable rocket propulsion stages.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. S. Somanath, S. Unnikrishnan Nair
